news.title: Jail nurse arrested after allegedly giving drugs to inmate she was romantically involved with
news.summary: A Fulton County Jail contract nurse was arrested after investigators said she provided an inmate with prescription medication he was not authorized to receive.

news.title: Judge stays execution of convicted murderer Stacey Humphreys
news.summary: A Cobb County judge has ordered a stay of execution for Stacey Ian Humphreys less than 24 hours before he was scheduled to die by lethal injection for a 2003 double murder.

news.title: FBI Atlanta: Crime is down across Georgia
news.summary: Violent crime dropped just over 6 percent over the past year statewide.

news.title: Teen charged as adult in ATM rape; police say he held woman at gunpoint for an hour
news.summary: A 16-year-old charged as an adult held a woman at gunpoint for more than an hour outside a Snellville credit union before dawn, a detective testified at a preliminary hearing.

news.title: 2 arrested following April deadly Old Fourth Ward shooting, police say
news.summary: Two men were arrested and are facing felony murder charges in connection with an April shooting in the Old Fourth Ward that killed a 29-year-old man, according to the Atlanta Police Department.

news.title: 3 arrested after shooting on Wilcoxen Street in Newnan, police say
news.summary: Three Newnan men face aggravated assault charges after a shooting on Saturday left bullet holes in nearby homes and led police to firearms and drugs, according to the Newnan Police Department.

news.title: Father speaks after son killed in shooting at Norfolk Southern site
news.summary: A man who witnesses said had just arrived for work was shot and killed Monday night in the employee parking lot of a Norfolk Southern intermodal facility in Austell.

news.title: Atlanta driver leads troopers on multi-county chase down GA 400
news.summary: A high-speed pursuit involving a stolen vehicle ended Tuesday morning when the driver crashed into a dump truck at a Forsyth County intersection, according to law enforcement.

news.title: Norfolk Southern contractor dies after shooting near railway property in Austell, officials say
